title: Rulebook v0.638 (pass 2 L-08) — “Date signed” on Color Belt’s family form and in the student summary
subtitle: Your rule v0.638 (“for signatures it should require date signed always”): every family form shows “Date signed” under the signature, filled in automatically with the day the form is sent, gray, and it can’t be changed; wherever staff see a signature, its date signed shows with it. The family form (/register/<code>, step 2) gets New students’ box (the same label, gray box and hint as their forms). Staff never see the drawn signature in Color Belt; they see “Signed by: Parent or guardian, on the form” in the student summary, so a “Date signed” row goes right under it (as Prospects shows it). No database change: the form already saves the day it was sent (signed_at), and the roster already reads it. A student added at the desk has no signature, so no row; one whose signature was deleted after 90 days keeps today’s line, which already gives the day. The After column is drawn on top of the real preview pages.

row.caption: Family form, PC 1280: nothing under the signature.
Student summary, PC 1280: “Signed by” with no day.
Family form, PC 1280: “Date signed” · Fri, Nov 6, 2026 (gray, can’t be changed) · “Filled in automatically with today’s date.”
Student summary, PC 1280: “Date signed: Oct 29” under “Signed by”.

footer: The words are New students’: “Date signed” and “Filled in automatically with today’s date.” The date on the form is the day it’s sent (as New students’ “Fri, Nov 6, 2026”); in the summary, the day the database saved with the signature (“Oct 29”, as the summary’s other days). Next, one question: who moves New students’ box and words into the shared files so every family form uses the same one.
